pages.title: Error-Correcting Code
pages.text: A Hamming code woven into a machine's control lines: every slip is caught and set right before it reaches the catalyst. Fitted to a machine, its catalysts wear on only every other run. One upgrade per machine. Made on the Cipher Loom.
Made in $(item)Cipher Loom$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Error Correction.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Gene Circuit.
